name: borage + horse chestnut + melilotus indicus seed
purpose: Uses: Temporarily relieves symptoms of varicose veins and leg cramps.
otcwarn: Warnings: Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a doctor before use for serious conditions, if conditions worsen or persist, or accidental ingestion occurs. If pregnant or nursing, consult a doctor before use. Avoid contact with eyes. SHAKE WELL BEFORE USE.
